summary: NXP Semiconductors N.V. filed an 8-K announcing that its subsidiary NXP B.V., along with NXP USA Inc. and NXP Funding LLC, redeemed $750 million in aggregate principal of its 3.875% senior notes due June 2026. The redemption was conducted per the indenture terms, funded by the issuer. The press release highlights capital allocation commitment alongside share repurchases and dividends. No premium, price per share, or board recommendation is specified as this is a debt redemption, not equity. Watch for potential impacts on leverage ratios and future capital allocation updates.
